appName: Night of the Undead: VR Zombie Shooter
displayName: Night of the Undead: VR Zombie Shooter
display_name: Night of the Undead: VR Zombie Shooter
display_long_description:
**THE DEAD WALK AGAIN**
 
The night has fallen, and the world belongs to the undead. Grab your weapon, steady your aim, and prepare to face endless waves of flesh-hungry zombies that never stop coming. Every headshot counts—precision brings power, and clean hits earn you valuable bonus points.

**FIGHT TO SURVIVE**

Armed with your trusted weapon, every second is a battle for survival. Zombies swarm from all directions — relentless, unpredictable, and faster than ever. Your reflexes and precision decide how long you’ll last. Line up the perfect headshot to take them down instantly and earn bonus points for your skill. Miss, and the horde grows stronger.

**COMPETE FOR GLORY**

Your survival isn’t the only thing on the line—so is your pride. Track your performance, climb the local leaderboard, and prove you’re the last shooter standing when the sun rises.

**REAL IMMERSION. REAL TERROR**

Built exclusively for VR, **Night of the Undead** immerses you in an intense first-person shooting experience where every movement matters. Feel the recoil, sense the tension, and witness the undead closing in from all sides. Each session is a unique test of endurance —  no second chances, just pure survival instinct.
Will you stand your ground when the shadows close in?
Can you survive until dawn… or will you become one of them?

**Night of the Undead** is now available in Early Access — jump in, test your aim, and prove you can survive the night!
